sections.title: Before booking in Huntsville
sections.html:
Write down the total price, divide it by the actual number of guests, and list what each person receives. Ask whether both guests get full draping, makeup advice, a fan and written guidance. Clarify the cancellation policy if one person cannot attend. A shared appointment is most useful when both people want the experience and have enough time for their own questions.

  • Does each person receive the same analysis and materials?
  • What happens to the group price if one guest cancels?

sections.title: Make the result useful in your everyday wardrobe
sections.html: If only one of you is curious, start individually with a phone palette and a small outfit experiment. If both want human feedback, a duet may make sense. Afterwards, keep your references separate; sharing a shopping trip does not mean sharing the same palette. Choose one new combination each and try it with clothes you already own before buying more.
